signature: SUBROUTINE ZLABRD( M, N, NB, A, LDA, D, E, TAUQ, TAUP, X, LDX, Y,

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows in the matrix A.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns in the matrix A.

params.name: nb
params.reference: The number of leading rows and columns of A to be reduced.

params.name: A
params.reference:
On entry, the m by n general matrix to be reduced. On exit, the first `NB` rows and columns of the matrix are overwritten; the rest of the array is unchanged. If $m \ge n$, elements on and below the diagonal in the first `NB`

-   columns, with the array `TAUQ`, represent the unitary
-   matrix Q as a product of elementary reflectors; and
-   elements above the diagonal in the first `NB` rows, with the
-   array `TAUP`, represent the unitary matrix P as a product
-   of elementary reflectors.

If $m < n$, elements below the diagonal in the first `NB`

-   columns, with the array `TAUQ`, represent the unitary
-   matrix Q as a product of elementary reflectors, and
-   elements on and above the diagonal in the first `NB` rows,
-   with the array `TAUP`, represent the unitary matrix P as
-   a product of elementary reflectors.

See Further Details.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: d
params.reference: The diagonal elements of the first `NB` rows and columns of the reduced matrix. $D(i) = A(i,i)$.

params.name: e
params.reference: The off-diagonal elements of the first `NB` rows and columns of the reduced matrix.

params.name: TAUQ
params.reference: The scalar factors of the elementary reflectors which represent the unitary matrix Q. See Further Details.

params.name: TAUP
params.reference: The scalar factors of the elementary reflectors which represent the unitary matrix P. See Further Details.

params.name: X
params.reference: The m-by-nb matrix X required to update the unreduced part of A.

params.name: ldx
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array X. $\mathrm{LDX} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: Y
params.reference: The n-by-nb matrix Y required to update the unreduced part of A.

params.name: ldy
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Y. $\mathrm{LDY} \ge \max (1,N)$.
